chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
Indeed, one of you may often be afflicted with fear of the ruler, and that is only because of sins. So guard yourselves against them as much as you are able, and do not persist in them.

key_terms.الْخَوْفُ: fear or anxiety experienced by a person
key_terms.بِالذُّنُوبِ: because of sins and acts of disobedience
key_terms.فَتَوَقَّوْهَا: so avoid them and guard yourselves against them

ai.seo_question: Why does a person frequently feel fear of the ruler according to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that recurring fear from the ruling authority may be a consequence of one's sins. It exhorts believers to avoid sins to the extent of their ability and not to continue in them deliberately.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If one of you is frequently afraid from the Sultan (ruling authority), and that is not except due to the sins. Therefore abstain up to what is your capacity, and do not be deliberate in it’.
en.sarwar: 27. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya’qub from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
You may feel afraid of a king because of your disobeying him. You must avoid it if you can and do not continue in such condition.”
